name: KINX Dogok IDC (DG)
notes: KINX official data-center page lists IDC Dogok 1 at 5F, Daelim Acrotel, 13 Eonju-ro 30-gil, Gangnam-gu (carrier-neutral interconnection hub with cloud on-ramps). Capacity not disclosed.

name: Digital Edge Seoul SEL1
notes: Carrier-neutral colocation at 646/646-1 Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu; Data Center Map lists 2.4 MW, PeeringDB confirms the Gangnam-gu address. Directory-derived capacity.

name: LG Uplus Nonhyeon Center
notes: LG Uplus legacy Nonhyeon data center in Gangnam-gu (first phase 1998); LG U+ official IDC center list confirms a downtown Seoul/Gangnam IDC. Public capacity not found.

name: KT Gangnam IDC
notes: KT Cloud colocation/IDC at 517 Eonju-ro, Gangnam-gu; capacity not disclosed in accessible public sources.

name: Moack Data Center
notes: Small colocation facility at 553-3 Dogok-dong, Gangnam-gu; capacity not found.

name: STT Seoul 1 (STT GDC Gasan)
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC)
notes: STT Seoul 1 in Gasan-dong, Geumcheon-gu, approx 40,000 sqm GFA, up to 30 MW IT load; completed (Jul 2025 per Dealbook) and fully commercial operations from June 2026 per official STT GDC release.

name: K-Square Data Centre Gasan (Koramco)
notes: Koramco's Gasan data center (approx 41,215 sqm) completed around May 2025 and put up for sale (naver blog/dealbook trade chatter); Cushman & Wakefield 1H2025 lists 26 MW in Geumcheon. Status operational post-completion.

name: KT Cloud Gasan AI Data Center (Gasan Iwill)
notes: KT Cloud hyperscale IDC in Gasan with 10 above-ground/5 basement floors, 100,000+ server capacity, 13 MW initial / 26 MW total IT load (C&W 1H2025); TheElec Jul 2025 summit quotes KT Cloud targeting a 40 MW Gasan center plus 80 MW Bucheon as next investments. Completion not yet confirmed - status construction.

name: DCI Seoul 01 (DCI SEL1, Gasan)
notes: Daelim started construction of the Gasan-dong new-build data center (JV with Australia's DCI Data Centers) on 29 Jan 2024; C&W 1H2025 lists DCI SEL1 in Geumcheon at 17,371 sqm / 12 MW among completed construction.

name: SK Broadband IDC Gasan Center
notes: JUNGLIM project page: completed 2021 data center in Geumcheon-gu, B5/10F, 69,088.65 sqm GFA; SKB Gasan supports SKT AI/GPU workloads (DCD reported ~46 MW IT load context for SKT/Lambda Gasan). Public IT load not confirmed.

name: LG CNS Gasan Digital Center
notes: LG CNS official page names Gasan IT Center among strategic data-center locations; Data Center Map lists 189 Gasan digital 1-ro, Geumcheon-gu at 20 MW (directory-derived).

name: KINX Gasan IDC (GS)
notes: KINX official page lists IDC Gasan at 3F, LG Gasan Digital Center, 189 Gasan digital 1-ro, Geumcheon-gu. Capacity not disclosed.

name: LOTTE Integrated Data Center
notes: LOTTE official pages list data-center business at 179 Gasan Digital 2-ro, Geumcheon-gu; public IT load not disclosed.

name: Guro Data Center (Gaebong-dong)
developer: Capstone Asset Management; operator KT Cloud
notes: DCD (Apr 2025): KT Cloud selected as operator of 30 MW data center under development at 166-2 Gaebong-dong, Guro-gu, after contract change; Data Center Map lists 19.8 MW IT. Korean construction blog confirms site at construction (groundwork) stage.

name: KT IDC Namguro
notes: KT opened its 14th IDC, KT IDC Namguro, in Guro-gu on 12 May 2021 - first 'branded IDC' in the Namguro IT valley, 335 racks, operated under lease by an IDC specialist per ZDNet.

name: Dreammark1 Guro IDC
notes: Dreammark1 and Dreamline official pages list Guro IDC / Dreammark1 Data Center at 61 Digital-ro 31-gil, Guro-gu. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Epsilon Global Hubs - Seoul
notes: Epsilon's Korea colocation/cloud-connect presence at 61 Digital-ro 31-gil, Guro-gu, colocated with Dreammark1; capacity not disclosed.

name: KT Seoul / Gwanghwamun IDC
notes: KT data center/colocation at 178 Sejong-daero (KT Gwanghwamun West building), Jongno-gu; Bloter confirms the Jongno-gu KT Gwanghwamun building. Public MW capacity not found.

name: KT Hyehwa IDC
notes: KT Hyehwa IDC at 65 Daehak-ro, Jongno-gu (directory listings); capacity not found.

name: Zenlayer SEL1 / SEL4 (Jongno)
notes: Zenlayer edge/colocation nodes in Jongno-gu: SEL1 at KT Gwanghwamun (178 Sejong-daero) and SEL4 at 65 Daehak-ro (Hyehwa); capacities not disclosed.

name: TELEHOUSE Seoul
notes: TELEHOUSE facility sheet places carrier-neutral Telehouse Seoul on 8F, Seoul Finance Center, Taepyeongno 1-ga / 136 Sejong-daero, Jung-gu; directories corroborate. Public MW capacity not found.

name: Digital Realty Seoul ICN10 (Sangam)
notes: Digital Realty's Seoul page lists ICN10 at 12 World Cup buk-ro 60-gil, Mapo-gu (Sangam-dong DMC), 132,000 sq ft / 12,263 sqm colocation space, max 12 MW IT, carrier-neutral, NVIDIA DGX-supported; opened Jan 2023, with 3 additional Korean sites planned (ZDNet Feb 2025).

name: LG CNS Sangam IT Center
notes: Data Center Map lists LG CNS Sangam IT Center at 424 World Cup buk-ro, Mapo-gu, 18 MW; KINX official page identifies same building as IDC Sangam 1. Capacity directory-derived.

name: KINX Sangam1 IDC (SA1)
notes: KINX official page lists IDC Sangam 1 inside LG CNS Sangam IT Center, 424 World Cup buk-ro, Mapo-gu. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Samsung SDS Sangam ICT Center
notes: Samsung SDS Sangam ICT Center at 24 World Cup buk-ro 60-gil, Mapo-gu, opened May 2015; KINX official page identifies same building as IDC Sangam 2. Capacity not found.

name: KINX Sangam2 IDC (SA2)
notes: KINX official page lists IDC Sangam 2 inside Samsung SDS Sangam IT Center, 24 World Cup buk-ro 60-gil, Mapo-gu (completed 2015). Capacity not disclosed.

name: Equinix SL1 (Sangam)
notes: Equinix SL1, Equinix's first South Korea data center, inside Samsung SDS Sangam IT Center, 24 World Cup buk-ro 60-gil, Mapo-gu; Data Center Map lists 2 MW (directory-derived).

name: Empirion KR1 Gangnam Data Center (GDC)
notes: Empyrion Digital (Singapore) held grand opening of KR1 Gangnam Data Center at Yangjae-dong 224, Seocho-gu (branded 'Gangnam' for the commercial district) on 2 Jul 2025; 37,714 sqm, Tier 3, 40 MW design / 29.4 MW IT load, first new data center in the Gangnam area in over a decade. Located in Seocho-gu despite the Gangnam brand.

name: SK Broadband Seoul / Seocho IDC
notes: SK Broadband data center at 6 Beobwon-ro 1-gil, Seocho-dong, Seocho-gu; Zenlayer lists SEL6 node inside the same facility. Capacity not disclosed.

name: LG Uplus SEOCHO1 (LG Telecom KIDC-1)
notes: LG Uplus SEOCHO1 at 2481 Nambusunhwan-ro, Seocho-dong; Data Center Map lists 9.5 MW, Baxtel 41,919 sqm / 3,456 racks. Directory-derived capacity.

name: Telstra Seoul (SEDS1)
notes: Telstra/Pacnet SEDS1 at 1423-1 Seocho-dong / 2481 Nambusunhwan-ro, Seocho-gu; PeeringDB corroborates. Capacity not found.
